name: Aitato
description: Aitato - adds new characters and content to Brotato. First character: DeepSeek (大肥鱼), who starts with a Scared Sausage and has -25% Elemental Damage modifications. When she stops moving she falls asleep: +10 HP Regeneration, and her art is swapped for a sleeping pose. 0.0.2: the starting weapon pool is now validated before use (scene must instantiate and satisfy vanilla weapon.gd's $Sprite/Hitbox contract), because a broken weapon scene makes this build kill the process with 0xC0000005 at Brotato.exe+0x1F8D28A on a method call against a null value.
